description: This file defines the ProductQuery class, which provides methods to query and filter product listings from a database, including building search and field filters, and integrating product info for website display.

classes.name: ProductQuery
classes.description: Query engine for product listing, handling filtering, searching, and integrating product info for website display.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ProductQuery object with settings, filters, and default fields.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs product search with optional attribute, field, and search term filters, and integrates product info.

methods.name: build_fields_filters
methods.description: Builds filters based on provided field-value pairs, handling multi-select fields.

methods.name: build_search_filters
methods.description: Builds search filters based on a search term across multiple item fields.
